entities.name: GraphRAG
entities.description: A method using graph community levels (C0-C3) to answer user queries.

entities.name: C0
entities.description: A condition using root-level community summaries (fewest in number) to answer user queries.

entities.name: C1
entities.description: A condition using high-level community summaries to answer queries.

entities.name: C2
entities.description: A condition using intermediate-level community summaries to answer queries.

entities.name: C3
entities.description: A condition using low-level community summaries (greatest in number) to answer queries.

entities.name: TS
entities.description: A text summarization method that applies a map-reduce approach directly to source texts.

entities.name: SS
entities.description: A vector RAG 'semantic search' approach where text chunks are retrieved until a token limit is reached.

entities.name: Map-Reduce
entities.description: A procedural approach used for summarization in the TS condition.

properties.mechanism: Shuffling and chunking for map-reduce stages

entities.name: Vector RAG
entities.description: A general approach implemented by SS, involving retrieval of text chunks based on semantic similarity.
